title: Des Moines and Canada
summary: They recall being treated well in Des Moines and Canada.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Who were you playing with when you were in Des Moines?
I was playing with a little bunch up there with, well to tell the truth, I was the same fellow Oliver Bibbs. Mm-hmm. See?
And who went to Canada? When I went to Canada?
Yeah, who were you playing with?
I was at the Royal American show then.
Big Royal American show, we'd go there every year.
And people treated you pretty nice, huh? Oh, yeah.
Yeah, you don't mind, you ain't got time to look at you. See?
